svg.title: Take payment
svg.desc: 1. checkout to payment-gateway, orders:charge: Request the charge from the payment gateway 2. payment-gateway to checkout, orders:charge-result: Report whether the charge succeeded 3. checkout to checkout, orders:paid: Record the order as paid
